---
title: "Marginalia"
---

A personal record of books, reading, and reflections.

```{r}
#| include: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(htmltools)

source("R/reading_helpers.R")

# Import our datasets
books <- read_csv(
  "data/books.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

reading_log <- read_csv(
  "data/reading_log.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Find the most recently recorded page for each book
latest_progress <- reading_log |>
  group_by(book_id) |>
  arrange(date, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  slice_tail(n = 1) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(book_id, page_reached)

# Join progress information to the book catalog
home_books <- books |>
  left_join(latest_progress, by = "book_id")

# Calculate summary statistics
books_finished <- sum(books$status == "Finished", na.rm = TRUE)

books_reading <- sum(books$status == "Reading", na.rm = TRUE)

pages_logged <- calculate_book_progress(
  books, reading_log
) |>
  summarise(total = sum(pages_read, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  pull(total)

# Create a reusable book card
book_card <- function(b) {

  link <- if (!is.na(b$book_page)) {
    sub("\\.qmd$", ".html", b$book_page)
  } else {
    "#"
  }

  cover <- if (!is.na(b$cover_id)) {
    paste0(
      "https://covers.openlibrary.org/b/id/",
      b$cover_id,
      "-M.jpg"
    )
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  details <- if (b$status == "Reading" &&
                 !is.na(b$page_reached) &&
                 !is.na(b$total_pages)) {
    paste0(
      "Page ", b$page_reached,
      " of ", b$total_pages,
      " (", round(100 * b$page_reached / b$total_pages, 1),
      "%)"
    )
  } else if (b$status == "Finished") {
    paste(
      "Finished:",
      if (is.na(b$date_finished)) {
        "Date not recorded"
      } else {
        format(b$date_finished, "%B %d, %Y")
      }
    )
  } else {
    b$status
  }

tags$div(
  class = "book-card",

    tags$a(
      href = link,
      if (!is.null(cover)) {
        tags$img(
          src = cover,
          alt = paste("Cover of", b$title),
          class = "book-cover"
        )
      }
    ),

    tags$div(
      tags$h3(tags$a(href = link, b$title)),
      tags$p(b$author),
      tags$p(details)
    )
  )
}

# Display a group of book cards

show_books <- function(data) {

  if (nrow(data) == 0) {
    return(tags$p("No books to display yet."))
  }

  cards <- lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(data)),
    function(i) book_card(data[i, ])
  )

  do.call(htmltools::tagList, cards)
}

```
